text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Dammit, I let first place slip away!!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Sheesh, who knew there were so many
crazy monsters running around?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Though Jungle Pocket wore her frustration openly,
there was a hint of bounce in her voice.
choice_data_list: Pokke... you seem like you're having fun?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
"It stings, but hey,
that's what makes competition so great!"

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
I don't need half-assed coddling.
If I lost to someone strong, I'll definitely beat them next time.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
If I win everything like that,
then I'll be the "strongest," right?
choice_data_list: I'll make you win next time!
I'll make sure you win next time!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
If I win everything like that,
then I'll be the "strongest," right?
choice_data_list: I'll make you win next time!
I'll make sure you win next time!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Just you watch.
Next time, I'm taking the top...!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, it's payback time, payback!
I'll leave the menu to you.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
I'll crush every opponent in my way!
...Which means I gotta get way stronger to make that happen!
